#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2:**

The state
 of willing
 reception
 and the
 state of interior
 confirmation proceed
 from the highest degrees
 of the Divine
 order. They
 are named
 thus
 because willing
 reception
 corresponds to the calling
 infl
ux of Divine truth, and interior confirmation
 corresponds to the recip
roc
al acknowledg
ment of the
 will. These are the two movements by
 which conjunction
 between
 the Divine and the human is effected
: the
 one
 belongs
 to what
 flows
 in,
 the other to what answers
 from
 within
.


**¶3:**
Just
 as the calling of
 Divine truth and the will
's ob
edient
 reception opened
 the interior
 passages
 through
 which Divine compassion could
 reach the in
most celestial principle
 of
 the human, so also
 these
 same
 states
 became passages
 of
 conjunction
 for Divine
 Wisdom
 as
 the
 nur
turing origin
 of spiritual
 life
 and
 Divine
 Love as the source
 of all living
 good
. The celest
ial will, having
 descended
 into obscurity, sought and found the
 liberating Divine truth that
 could
 deliver
 it
.
 And
 likewise
 Divine
 Love and Divine Wisdom sought that
 active
 proceeding principle
 —
 the celest
ial will itself
 —
 which
 had gone
 forth from them
 into
 the realm of contest
;
 but
 the calling of
 truth
 and the reception of the will became the
 sole
 means of reaching
 it
.

**¶4:**

In
 this manner
,
 the
 calling
 and
 the reception become
 passages
 through
 which all
 the successive
 heav
enly degrees of the Divine order reach
 down
 toward
 the celest
ial will and
 toward
 every
 human
 aff
ection that
 has
 become
 con
joined with spiritual
 death. They become sust
aining goods
 and tru
ths that support the celest
ial will
 during
 its elevation
 out
 of natural darkness. They restore
 it
 to conjunction
 with the Divine Love that
 origin
ates life
 and the
 Divine Wisdom that nur
tures it
. They are the
 tru
ths that purify every
 living
 aff
ection,
 serving
 as sust
aining powers
 and as
 rest
or
ers of interior
 perception and conscience —
 whether the
 soul dwells in a state of growing
 understanding
 or
 remains
 held
 within
 the conditions
 of the merely
 natural and
 corporeal life
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The assent and the amen have come about from these great ones of the powers. They were given the name as the assent belongs to the summons and the amen belongs to the answer.

Just as the summons and the obedience are the ones that opened the portals of mercy and entreaty for the First Man, so they also became portals for the Mother of Life and the Father of the living. The First Man sought and found his redeemer. And also the Mother of Life and the Father of the living sought [after] this runner, who came forth from them, who is the First Man; but the summons and the obedience became the portals for them.

Now, in this way they have become portals for the aeons of greatness towards the First Man, and the soul that was conjoined with death. They became helpers [and redeemers] of the First Man during his ascent. They gave him [back to] the Father of Life and the Mother of Life [who had sent him forth]. They are purifiers of the living soul, being helpers and bestowers of remembrance for it, be it either in [the fruit] in the tree or in the creation of flesh [and blood].
